answer: Prayers & Duties >> Qurbani (Slaughtering) Question ID: 48932 Country: AU Title: Qurbani in Share of one who has doubtful income Question: Is it allowable for me to take share in qurbani with my relatives when one of their income is doubtful to me? They are from my first relative. What should I do to avoid fitna by creating such separation when other relatives (who are taking share in the same qurbani) do not aware of his source of income? Answer ID: 48932 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1497/1243/H=11/1434) If you fear fitnah in case of cancelling him, then you should separate yourself and do your qurbani individually or with people with whom you are satisfied. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
